jobs.description: Employer: Indiana Biosciences Research Institute Expires: 11/10/2026 IBRI is poised to transform life sciences—and for millions of people, even life itself.The Opportunity:The IBRI is seeking motivated undergraduate or graduate students for our Summer Internship Program. About Us:The Indiana Biosciences Research Institute (IBRI) is a first-in-class translational medicine institute dedicated to advancing life sciences in the race to eliminate disease and improve human health and life.By connecting early-stage biotech companies with cutting-edge life science discoveries —and backed by the mission and resources of industry leaders, investors, and philanthropic partners—IBRI is successfully evolving a new, independent model to conquer disease, uniting previously fragmented forces in the quest for cures.Carefully curating and supporting early-stage companies with investment, talent, and space, IBRI strategically accelerates drug discovery. Our work benefits from the relatively low cost of living and doing business here, allowing more resources to be directed toward science.Fueled by the same entrepreneurial creativity as the groundbreaking scientific work we support, IBRI’s labs advance research across the frontiers of diabetes, metabolic disease, Alzheimer’s disease, and rare pediatric diseases. Our ambitious public–private vision cultivates talent while efficiently bridging the gap between research-driven inquiry and profit-driven drug development.At IBRI, cures are launched on a clear pathway to clinical trials, enabled by the combined resources and experience of our academic and industry partners, without the typical pressure to deliver rapid results for commercialization. IBRI labs pursue breakthroughs that might never happen elsewhere. Breakthroughs are happening here. Our novel financing model ensures that when discoveries are ready for clinical trials, the intellectual property is sold back to industry or spun off, creating a direct stream of revenue.By every measure, the IBRI model demonstrates a novel approach that delivers rewards. Scientific bench work is nurtured, drug discovery is advanced, workforce development is continuous, investors see returns, and donors see impact. Most importantly, IBRI’s structure and portfolio of accomplishments matter to the patients whose lives are improved—or even saved—by this forward-looking approach to life sciences.IBRI is driven to bring next-generation therapies to market with an understanding of the complex pressures that often bind innovation to economics. jobs.description: Employer: Man Group Expires: 11/10/2026 The TeamMan Systematics’ Fast Trading Strategies (FTS) team is responsible for the development of high Sharpe, high-frequency trading strategies across all asset classes. The team has been running for over a decade and currently manages a large and successful portfolio across both global futures and cash markets. The FTS team is responsible for the full end to end development of the fast alpha portfolio, using several techniques to capture fast alphas, ML, event driven, microstructure based etc, building its own customized monetization stack, and optimizing trading and order placement with dedicated high-frequency infrastructure.This posting is specifically for candidates interested in interning in the New York office, which houses Man Systematics’ business unit focused on high-frequency alpha research, trading, and infrastructure.Who Should Apply?The team is currently hiring PhD students for an MLE/QR internship with strong academic achievement in highly technical degree programs who are interested in a summer internship (expected to be between 10 – 12 weeks).Candidates are encouraged to submit only one application using their university email address via the below link, which requires a resume that includes all completed and in-progress post-secondary education GPAs. School transcripts may be optionally provided immediately or later in the process.Kindly note that our summer internships are open to penultimate year students only.Purpose of the RoleThe MLE role is ideal for individuals who are passionate about software that is focused on machine learning applications such as MLOps and research workflows. Because MLEs are also expected to use their own software, the ideal candidate not only has experience coding in a variety of languages (especially Python) but also has knowledge of ML algorithms and research processes.The QR role is ideal for individuals who are passionate about using high frequency tick data and machine learning algorithms to predict asset returns and converting those models into profitable trading strategies. QRs will work closely with MLOps in deploying models and therefore are required to be strong programmers in a variety of languages (especially Python). Previous ML or statistical research internship experience in finance, technology, or academia is strongly preferred.Working HereMan Systematic fosters a performance driven, meritocratic culture with a small company, no-attitude feel. It is flat structured, open, transparent, and collaborative, offering ample opportunity to grow and have enormous impact on what we do. We are actively engaged with the broader research and academic community, as well as renowned industry contributors.We’re fortunate enough to have a modern high-rise office in central Midtown conveniently located near Central Park and continually strive to make our environment a great place in which to work.We have annual away days and research off-sites for the whole team.We open-source some of our technology. See https://github.com/man-groupWe regularly talk at leading industry conferences, and tweet about relevant technology and how we’re using it. See @manquanttech and @ManGroup.Our Oxford lab is collocated with the Oxford-Man Institute of Quantitative Finance (https://bit.ly/36goTic) and the Machine Learning Research Group in Engineering Science, University of Oxford (https://bit.ly/2MSHDwy)

estimating, and logistics systems.Coordinate with engineering counterparts, management, and operations departments, including supplier security, fleet support and logistics, quality, and finance, to responsibilities of the position.What You Can Expect:A culture that values people through recognition of accomplishments, work-life balance, and a sense of community.A diverse group of talented Strong analytical ability to solve problems and ability to learn quickly. Strong written & verbal communication skills to generate process instructions and reports. Ability to follow a structured project management process including document meeting minutes, action items, and monitor progress. Capability and tenacity for solving unique engineering problems. Ability to learn quickly and a desire to keep improving skills and to teach others when possible. Team player with a highly proactive and positive attitude with ability to work on own or in a team as needed. Hands-on skills. Demonstrated interest in building and testing. Regular, predictable attendance is required. Please note that estimated time for start/end dates are based on Spring 2027. Other semesters will have different dates. Want to know more about each of our Area Assignments? Let our managers tell you! Conversion Engineering: The Conversion Engineering Team is responsible for controller-generators and starter-generators (as well as converting the power they produce). We design and support multiple products with our current new product introduction (NPI) programs. The Mechanical Engineering Team designs the housings and assembly methods for our systems, ensuring they meet strict environmental and operational requirements. Their work is essential to delivering robust and reliable solutions for our aerospace applications. Embedded Systems Engineering: If you're curious about how hardware and software come together to power real-world systems and are eager to make an impact while learning from experienced engineers - join our Embedded Systems Engineering team. Industrialization Engineering: Industrialization is the perfect blend of design and manufacturing work. We have a mix of both in reviewing engineering drawings, discussing design features, developing solutions, mitigating design risks, managing prototype builds, building tooling, and implementing new products into production. We get the benefit of working with every department in the business and every day is different. If you want to have a mix of design work behind a desk and time on the production floor seeing designs you helped create come to life - then Industrialization is right for you! Manufacturing Engineering: As a Co-Op, you will work directly with our production team and design engineers to support the assembly and troubleshooting of aircrafts power-conversion units. We perform root-cause analysis on units that fail functional testing, remove roadblocks for our production team, diagnose defective parts, improve assembly processes, update work instructions, and initiate corrective actions. If you want hands-on experience on the shop floor and to improve efficiency while reducing waste - apply for Manufacturing Engineering. Production Support Engineering: Working in Production Support Engineering you will have the opportunity to work on real products and support day-to-day engineering activities that directly impact production, product reliability, and customer satisfaction. Responsibilities may include assisting with failure investigations, supporting resolution of production and supplier-related issues, evaluating nonconforming hardware, participating in repair and overhaul activities, reviewing engineering documentation, and contributing to engineering changes that improve product performance, manufacturability, and long-term supportability. Project Management: Everything starts with an idea, and project managers bring ideas into reality. From managing and executing plans, creative problem solving, and balancing the needs and expectations of a cross-functional team; project managers touch every aspect of the business and the world around us. With Project Management at Safran you will get real world understanding of how products and projects come to life, leveraging the strength of the team and how to manage risks and budget along the way. Quality Engineering: If you're looking to help ensure customer satisfaction and promote continual improvement of our products and processes, then the Quality Team may be for you. Our team is responsible for maintaining our Quality Management System (QMS), facilitating Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), and conducting internal quality audits. We promote continual improvement in the form of corrective actions and improvement projects. Rotating Machines Engineering: The mechanical design team within the Rotating Machines Department excels in engineering robust and high-performance aircraft rotating machinery. This includes generators and starter-generator systems. This group specializes in designing critical mechanical components such as rotors, stators, shafts, bearings, splines, and housings to ensure reliability and efficiency under demanding aerospace conditions. Supply Chain Engineering: Supply Chain is where ideas are transformed into finished products. We partner closely with suppliers to secure everything the business requires—from engineering components to the materials, equipment, and services that support daily operations. You'll gain firsthand experience in turning plans into reality by collaborating with suppliers, resolving challenges, and ensuring materials flow efficiently throughout the process. Systems/ Analysis Engineering: The System Integration & Performance Team develops, integrates, and validates aerospace electrical power systems by bringing together hardware, software, and control systems into a complete solution. Team members support system testing, performance analysis, troubleshooting, and certification activities to ensure products meet customer and regulatory requirements. Test Engineering: The Test Engineering Team specializes in test design, execution, and reporting for all power units. The team is composed of both test engineers and test equipment engineers. The test engineers handle the design, setup, execution, reporting of research and development testing, and qualification testing of new products and/or systems. Meanwhile, the test equipment engineering team design mechanical, electrical, and control equipment for the test lab to enable both production and new product testing to take place. Through Life Support Engineering: The Through Life Support Engineering team works on the problems that happen after designs enter production. The team investigates failures (both in the field and on the production line), solves production and supplier issues, supports repair and overhaul activity, evaluates nonconforming hardware, manages obsolescence, and develops design and drawing changes that keep products operating safely and reliably throughout their service life. For Co-Ops, it is a great opportunity to work on real hardware, see how engineering decisions affect the entire product lifecycle, and gain hands-on experience through a wide variety of technical challenges compared to working on a piece of a long-term development program.

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Internship Program - Office of Employee Benefits (Finance and Accounting) at Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta
jobs.description: Employer: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Expires: 11/11/2026 As an employee of the Atlanta Fed, you will help support our mission of promoting the stability and efficiency of the U.S. economy and financial system. Your work will affect the economy of the Southeast, the United States, and the world. The work we do here is important, and how we do it is just as important as what we do. We live our values of integrity, excellence, and respect every day. We do the right thing, we do things right, and we treat people right. A career at the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta gives you the chance to do work that touches lives and helps communities prosper. OUR BANK - The Federal Reserve is the central bank of the United States and is one of the most influential, trusted, and prestigious financial organizations. It consists of twelve Reserve Banks located around the country and the Board of Governors in Washington, D.C. The Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta territory covers the Sixth Federal Reserve District, which includes Alabama, Florida, and Georgia, and portions of Louisiana, Mississippi, and Tennessee. The Atlanta Fed and the other Reserve Banks play an important part in all three of the Fed's functions: monetary policy, bank supervision and regulation, and the operation of a nationwide payment system. PLEASE READ:Internships are paid. Summer housing will not be provided. This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, performance standards or requirements, efforts, skills or working conditions associated with the job. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks be performed when circumstances change (e.g. emergencies, rush jobs, change in workload or technological developments). The Office of Employee Benefits (OEB), located in Newark, N.J., comprises a staff of 64 professionals who oversee benefit programs for approximately 80,000 current and former employees of the Federal Reserve, and their beneficiaries. The OEB was established in 1934 to administer the Federal Reserve System’s Retirement [pension] Plan. Over time, the OEB's responsibilities have expanded to include additional retirement benefits, health benefits, life insurance, long-term disability, and other personal protection plans. The OEB's mission is to be a center of excellence, providing leadership in formulating employee benefit programs and operating these programs on behalf of the Reserve Banks, Board of Governors and Consumer Financial Protection Bureau with outstanding customer service, sound and cost-efficient operations, professional expertise, and ongoing innovation. Summer finance intern at the OEB will be placed into the Finance and Accounting Department and will be involved in projects supporting retirement plans, health and welfare program as well as budget assignments.The program is extremely competitive, and size is limited. As a summer intern at the OEB, applicants must have a demonstrated interest in business, finance, benefits, human resources, information systems, legal, compliance, communications or a related discipline and a strong academic record. Specific skills may be required depending on area and project. This program is open to rising juniors pursuing a bachelor’s degree. Responsibilities:• Hands-on accounting experience• Live reconciliations, journal entries, and applicable financial reporting and general ledger work• Practical applicable of controls (COSO and ICOFR)• Support automation efforts through testing and build (projects) Qualifications:• Working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, MS PowerPoint; • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills demonstrated by the ability to assimilate new information, make sound decisions, and manage multiple tasks; • Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and written; • Ability to grasp information quickly; • Attention to detail; and • Ability to work productively in a high-performing, collegial atmosphere. Please include resume, cover letter and unofficial transcript. You should indicate your work area(s) of interest in your cover letter. CORE COMPETENCIES:Proficient in Microsoft Office SuiteExcellent communication skills (verbal and written)Strong analytical skillsAbility to work independently and take ownership of projectsGreat work ethic and detail orientedComfortable working across time zones to complete projects in a timely manner OUR BENEFITS TO INTERNS (some benefits are subject to being onsite):Professional development opportunitiesNetworkingFree LinkedIn Learning accessFree access to our FedFuel career development toolDress for your dayFlexible hours TO APPLY:In addition to your application, please attach a resume and a copy of your most recent unofficial transcript. Additional Requirements: This position will require at minimum fingerprinting for a criminal background check, education and employment verification, along with potential additional screening requirements due to the information accessed while performing the job. Any offer of employment is contingent upon satisfactory results of any required background screening. These screenings would be initiated at the time of offer acceptance and can take up to approximately 8 weeks to be completed. The screening covers areas such as education/employment verification, criminal history, credit history, and reaches out to your references and people that know you well. For Law Enforcement positions, physical, psychological, drug, stress/EKG, and attending an academy will be required. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta employees must comply with the Bank’s ethics rules. These rules generally prohibit employees, their spouses/domestic partners, and minor children from holding financial interests (such as common stock and corporate bonds) issued by financial institutions. This prohibition also applies to investment funds that focus on investing in the financial sector. If you, your spouse/domestic partner, or minor child own such securities, you will generally be asked to divest them if you accept an offer of Bank employment. If you have concerns about this prohibition, you should raise the issue with the recruiter for this posting early in the process. This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, performance standards or requirements, efforts, skills or working conditions associated with the job. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks be performed when circumstances change (e.g. emergencies, rush jobs, change in workload or technological developments). The Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description: Employer: SAP America, Inc. Expires: 11/11/2026 We help the world run betterAt SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. What You’ll Build The SAP Internship Experience Program is SAP’s global, strategic, paid internship program that provides university students with opportunities to find purpose in their careers. This is more than an internship; it’s the foundation for a career built on connection, creativity, and impact. Position title: SAP iXp Intern - Sales Development Executive Location (Mandatory): Alpharetta, GA *SAP is not offering relocation benefits for this role at this time Duration: 6 Months (with potential 6 month extension) Schedule: 40 HR/week Ideal Start: ASAP Work Authorization: SAP is not offering current or future visa sponsorship for this role at this time. In this role, you’ll: You will prospect and set meetings for the account executives aligned to the territories by making cold calls, sending emails, and utilizing social media platforms like linkedin.Responsible for territory strategy, coverage, demand generation planning & execution to ensure coverage and collaboration with stakeholders across the organization, including; Sales, Demand Management, Marketing and others as required.Build incremental cloud pipeline by finding and creating opportunities for net-new customers to deliver incremental revenue through upselling and cross-selling efforts.Qualify leads and progress throughout the first phases of the sales cycle.Communicating sales plan regularly with key stakeholders.Update and maintain reporting tools such as CRM to ensure accurate pipeline management. What You’ll Bring We’re looking for someone who takes initiative, perseveres, knows how to overcome rejection, and stays curious. You like to work on meaningful innovative projects and are energized by lifelong learning. • Education: Bachelors or Masters degree in a related field. Graduating Seniors/2nd Year Masters highly desirable• Eligibility: Must be currently enrolled, or recently graduated (start date must be within 6 months of graduation date) from a coding academy/bootcamp, apprenticeship, associate, bachelor’s, master’s or JD/PhD program. • A high-energy team player with the ability to develop strong relationships with customers and sales.• Results oriented person with a passion to learn and a desire to run their business.• Self-starters & Constant Learners only.• Excellent verbal & written presentation skills.• Proven ability of managing or working as part of virtual team an advantage.• Quota driven and a strong desire to succeed.• Desired skills / experience to be successful in this role: cold outreach experience Where You Belong Be part of SAP Next Gen, a global community for students, universities, schools and educational partners, who are passionate about innovation and technology. Grow professionally through personalized mentoring, coaching, and career development support.Project-driven Experience: Kickstart your career with hands-on learning experience, making an impact from day one by contributing to meaningful projects that help the world run better. You’ll have endless learning resources at your fingertips and gain future-ready skills from a variety of virtual, in-person, and hybrid learning sessions, cultivated just for you, and aligned with our learning approach.Gain Visibility: Build relationships with leaders and peers across teams and functions. Showcase your ideas, skills, and creativity in a global, fast-paced environment. Open doors for future career opportunities within SAP and beyond. Grow with one of the most successful sales organizations in the world as a Sales Development Executive Intern (SDE). You will join a team of professionals in a sales focused career path. The overall mission of the Sales Development team is to find and build cloud opportunities for net new customers. The primary responsibility of the SDE Intern is to build and manage pipeline of cloud and software license opportunities for Net-New customers, and, deliver incremental revenue through upselling and cross-selling efforts. jobs.description: Employer: Northwestern Mutual - Orange County Expires: 11/11/2026 OverviewThe Financial Services Sales Program is a paid, 12-week early-career experience where students have an opportunity to explore the path to becoming a Northwestern Mutual Financial Representative. Through comprehensive training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and real client-facing experience, you'll develop foundational sales, relationship-building, and communication skills while exploring whether an entrepreneurial advisor career is right for you. You can build a go-to-market strategy and business plan, learn how advisors conduct client conversations about financial goals and needs, and understand how they help guide individuals toward solutions tailored to their needs. Along the way, you'll see how advisors earn trust, develop lasting client relationships, and recommend insurance, investment, and wealth solutions that support a client's broader financial goals. Unlike many traditional internships, this program is built around real responsibility and practical application. You'll learn through experiencing and doing, not just observing. Our goal is to provide a depth of experience that helps you build valuable professional skills, understand what it takes to grow a business, and make a meaningful impact in the lives of others. By the end of the program, you'll have a clearer understanding of the advisor career path and the opportunity to determine whether it's the right fit for your future.Schedule: Flexible, designed to work around classes and other commitments Compensation: Up to $3,000 in activity-based pay, plus commission on sales. Explore an Entrepreneurial Career with Clarity: Get experience learning how business development, client relationships, accountability, and compensation contribute to long-term success. What You'll DoIn the Financial Services Sales Program, you'll: Develop foundational sales skills through hands-on client interactions, including hosting discovery conversations to understand their priorities and goals.Build a market of potential clients through prospecting, personal connections, referrals, and new relationships. Learn about Northwestern Mutual's holistic financial planning approach and how advisors develop recommendations across insurance, investments, retirement, and other financial decisions. Work alongside experienced financial advisors through mentorship and joint work opportunities. Secure required Life, Accident & Health insurance licensing By completing the available training in this program, including holding the College Agent’s Contract, meeting licensing requirements, building your network, conducting discovery conversations, participating in client planning activities, applying coaching feedback, and engaging in business development, you will be better positioned for success in this program or whatever career you may choose. How Compensation WorksCompensation is tied to completing sales- and business-focused program activities, including conducting financial discovery conversations and learning how advisors prepare personalized recommendations. Additional compensation takes the form of commissions from eligible sales. Here's how it works: You can earn up to $3,000 during the program based on completing sales and business development activities You also have the opportunity to earn commissions from sales There is no salary or hourly compensation QualificationsWho This Early-Career Program Is For We're looking for students who are: Currently enrolled full-time in college (juniors and seniors preferred) Interested in learning about financial planning, business development, entrepreneurship, or sales Comfortable building relationships and starting conversations with others Motivated by personal growth and professional development Able to independently manage priorities, responsibilities, and accountability Curious about exploring the financial representative career through direct experience rather than observation aloneEligible participants may be considered for a full-time financial representative role following graduation. Participants may also be considered for another role within their local network office

jobs.feedName: David Nazarian College of Business & Economics
jobs.title: Student Trainee Management and Program Analyst at U.S. Department of Energy
jobs.description: Employer: U.S. Department of Energy Expires: 11/12/2026 Student Trainee Management and Program AnalystLocation: Washington, District of Columbia, United States Work Model: Onsite Employment Type: Full-Time Position Type: InternshipThis internship is located in the Office of Energy Dominance Financing (EDF).Join DOE's Power Up program and kickstart your federal career! This program is designed to offer exciting early-career opportunities for upcoming professionals ready to make an impact in the Federal government.As a participant, you will be paired with an on-the-job mentor whose guidance is tailored specifically to your career path-whether you are entering a technical specialty or an administrative/professional role. In this program, mentoring goes far beyond basic job training. Your mentor will serve as a trusted guide, helping you build confidence, develop professional skills, and learn how to navigate and thrive within a structured, mission-driven environment.The U.S. Department of Energy's Office of Energy Dominance Financing (EDF) supports high-impact energy and manufacturing initiatives that advance U.S. energy security, affordability, grid reliability, and national competitiveness. EDF works closely with private-sector partners, other federal agencies, and key stakeholders to finance projects that strengthen America's energy foundation and support emerging technologies. As an EDF intern, you will gain unparalleled professional development by engaging in large-scale loan evaluations for innovative energy projects, building expertise in financial modeling, due diligence, and credit risk analysis. This opportunity provides a unique opportunity to contribute to the national good by directly supporting the revitalization and innovation of the U.S. energy industry, enabling the deployment of energy technologies and fostering American economic prosperity.EDF interns may participate in research, analysis, and program support across these focus areas, gaining exposure to federal energy finance, public-private partnerships, and cross-agency collaboration.As a Power Up Intern in the Office of Energy Dominance Financing (EDF), you will support our daily mission goals.EDF's work includes:- Energy generation and grid reliability projects- Innovative energy technology initiatives- Manufacturing and advanced transportation projects- Tribal energy investment and partnership projects- CO2 transportation and infrastructure projects- Energy solutions that support U.S. leadership in artificial intelligence and other emerging technologiesFor more information, visit Energy Dominance Financing Program | Department of Energy.

jobs.title: Wealth Management Intern at Integrated Private Wealth
jobs.description: Employer: Integrated Private Wealth Expires: 11/12/2026 Wealth Management Intern Advisor Support, Client Service and AI Workflows Location San Diego, CAPosition Paid, part-time internshipReports to Erick Conway, Financial AdvisorHourly rate [Approved range]Weekly hours [To be confirmed]Work arrangement and start date [To be confirmed] About the roleIntegrated Private Wealth is building a premier private wealth platform serving successful entrepreneurs, executives, and families with complex financial lives. The Wealth Management Intern will work closely with financial advisor Erick Conway to improve workflows, support client service, and learn how a wealth management practice operates. An early priority will be helping build and refine processes using AI agents and Quin, while shadowing Erick and learning the planning and investment strategies used with clients. This paid, part-time opportunity is designed for someone interested in a long-term financial planning career who brings practical AI experience, attention to detail, and a genuine commitment to service. The potential progression is from internship to full-time Client Service Associate and, over time, junior Financial Advisor. What success looks likeErick spends less time coordinating routine administration. Client information and follow-ups are accurate and organized, and approved AI workflows reduce repetitive work without compromising quality. The intern demonstrates growing knowledge, sound judgment, and readiness for broader responsibility. Key responsibilitiesAI workflows and process improvementWork with Erick to map recurring tasks and identify opportunities to improve meeting preparation, follow-up, documentation, and client onboarding.Help configure, test, and refine AI agents and Quin-supported workflows; document instructions, review outputs for accuracy, and recommend practical improvements.Use firm-approved tools and authorized information only. Obtain approval before implementing automations or using them for client communications or account activity. Advisor and meeting supportCoordinate scheduling, meeting logistics, agendas, and background materials for selected client, prospect, and professional-partner meetings.Shadow Erick in selected meetings, capture action items, and prepare follow-up drafts for review.Track commitments, maintain organized records, and alert Erick to unresolved items, changing priorities, or potential delays. Client onboarding and service supportAssist with document collection, account-opening paperwork, asset-transfer follow-up, and routine client requests under supervision.Maintain accurate client information, notes, tasks, and service status in approved systems; coordinate handoffs with IPW client-service colleagues.Learn the end-to-end onboarding and service process for relationships Erick leads. Client advice, recommendations, and transaction authorizations remain with authorized professionals. Learning and professional developmentLearn how planning, investments, tax considerations, estate planning, and client service fit together through shadowing, assigned research, and coaching.Apply feedback, document what you learn, and build the knowledge and judgment needed for increasing responsibility. Qualifications RequiredRelevant coursework in financial planning, finance, business, economics, accounting, or a related field, with a clear interest in a financial planning career.Hands-on experience creating, configuring, and using AI agents or automated workflows. Coursework, personal projects, internships, and professional experience may demonstrate this capability.Strong organization, attention to detail, written and verbal communication, and comfort learning new technology.Dependability, punctuality, discretion, and a willingness to learn, follow instructions, investigate routine problems, and ask for guidance when needed. PreferredCollege senior expecting to graduate in May 2027, with interest in potential full-time employment in San Diego by summer 2027.Experience in client service, administrative support, financial services, or another professional environment.Familiarity with Quin, CRM systems, workflow tools, or financial-planning software; experience documenting processes and testing AI outputs. Prior wealth management employment or an advanced technical background is not required. Candidates should be prepared to discuss an AI agent or workflow they have built, what it accomplished, and how they checked its accuracy. Key competencies Client Mindset Approaches every interaction with care, responsiveness, and professionalism; understands that reliable follow-through is part of excellent service. Stewardship Takes ownership of assigned work, communicates status, and follows commitments through to completion within the scope of training and supervision. Attention to Detail and Quality Checks information and work products, including AI-generated outputs, and raises inconsistencies before they create client problems. Learning Agility and Growth Mindset Seeks feedback, retains and applies learning, and develops financial planning knowledge alongside practical technology skills. Organization, Prioritization and Reliability Manages tasks and deadlines, arrives prepared, and communicates availability or competing priorities in advance. Builder’s Mindset Looks for better ways of working, investigates routine issues, and helps turn improvements into documented, repeatable processes. Team Orientation and Discretion Works constructively with Erick and IPW colleagues, communicates clearly, and protects confidential client and firm information. Why Integrated Private Wealth IPW is entering a significant period of growth. We serve entrepreneurs and families navigating complex financial decisions, tax strategies, estate planning, and generational wealth. For someone beginning a financial planning career, this is an opportunity to learn alongside experienced professionals, contribute to client service, and help improve how the work gets done.

jobs.description: Employer: KWH Constructors, Inc. Expires: 11/12/2026 Estimating Intern | Bridge & Heavy Civil Construction — Estimating Learn how bridges get priced, bid, and won—from the people who build them.Reports To: Project Manager Location: Issaquah, WA, with potential site visits to West Coast and Alaska projects Eligibility: Rising Juniors and Seniors currently enrolled in an accredited Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related programWhy You’ll Love This Role ✓ Genuinely hands-on — you’ll work on real bids, not just shadow or file paperwork. ✓ 1:1 mentorship from experienced bridge and heavy civil estimators. ✓ Pre-bid site walks and visits to active projects, where you see how the work you helped price actually gets built. ✓ Exposure to a wide range of bridge work — new structures, replacements, widenings, seismic retrofits, and rehabilitation. ✓ Strong potential path to a full-time Junior Estimator offer, after graduation. ✓ Competitive pay: $25.00 – $30.00 per hour, plus [housing/travel stipend if applicable].Who Thrives HereAs an Estimating Intern, you’ll get a real, hands-on introduction to bridge and heavy civil estimating — working alongside senior estimators, project managers, and engineers to turn plans and specifications into competitive, buildable bids. Applications from students who are starting college/university during the 2026-27 academic year will not be considered.Applicants must be available to work 15-30 hours per week during regular business hours for at least the winter/spring term (November/December through May). Students who are available to continue working during the 2027 summer term are strongly preferred. jobs.description: Employer: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Expires: 11/13/2026 As an employee of the Atlanta Fed, you will help support our mission of promoting the stability and efficiency of the U.S. economy and financial system. Your work will affect the economy of the Southeast, the United States, and the world. The work we do here is important, and how we do it is just as important as what we do. We live our values of integrity, excellence, and respect every day. We do the right thing, we do things right, and we treat people right. A career at the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta gives you the chance to do work that touches lives and helps communities prosper. OUR BANK - The Federal Reserve is the central bank of the United States and is one of the most influential, trusted, and prestigious financial organizations. It consists of twelve Reserve Banks located around the country and the Board of Governors in Washington, D.C. The Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta territory covers the Sixth Federal Reserve District, which includes Alabama, Florida, and Georgia, and portions of Louisiana, Mississippi, and Tennessee. The Atlanta Fed and the other Reserve Banks play an important part in all three of the Fed's functions: monetary policy, bank supervision and regulation, and the operation of a nationwide payment system. PLEASE READ: Internships are paid. Summer housing will not be provided. This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, performance standards or requirements, efforts, skills or working conditions associated with the job. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks be performed when circumstances change (e.g. emergencies, rush jobs, change in workload or technological developments). Learn the fundamental concepts and processes of the bank's Internal Audit function. Candidate will be provided basic training around auditing and risk management principles.Additionally, the intern will gain "on-the-job-training" through shadowing a tenured auditor, throughout the Audit Lifecycle.Additional project participation opportunities may also be available throughout the program. Any offer of employment is contingent upon satisfactory results of any required background screening. These screenings would be initiated at the time of offer acceptance and can take up to approximately 8 weeks to be completed. The screening covers areas such as education/employment verification, criminal history, credit history, and reaches out to your references and people that know you well. jobs.description: Employer: Protiviti Expires: 11/13/2026 Protiviti Business Performance Improvement Intern - 2027 Are You Ready to Live Something Different with Protiviti? The Protiviti career provides an opportunity to learn, shape outcomes, and grow within a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture. We hire curious individuals who are motivated by learning and who are driven to make an impact. By teaming with our clients, we solve the business challenges a dynamic world presents and discover and implement innovative business solutions. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver. At every level, we champion leaders who live our values. Are you inspired to make a difference? You've come to the right place. We assist organizations in developing differentiated employee experiences to better attract, retain, and engage talent. We also help organizations enable sustained behavior changes to support large-scale initiatives. Supply Chain & Operations: Supports companies in driving outcomes by reducing cost, improving efficiency, reducing risk and executing operations across their complex business functions from Engineering, Source, Make and Deliver through industry-leading practices and innovation. Meaningful onboarding. Impactful training. Foundational learning. These experiences define Protiviti’s award-winning internship – an experience that builds upon your skills and knowledge and enables you to thrive professionally. We encourage thoughtful choices about where work happens – making decisions that best support client outcomes, team effectiveness and learning. Conduct opportunity sizing, business and market assessments, competitive analyses, and other quantitative and qualitative analyses to inform investment and prioritization decisions. Help assess progress against strategic priorities, identify risks and dependencies, and synthesize implications for leadership. Synthesize external insights into implications for CSI’s businesses, portfolio, and long-term strategic direction. jobs.description: Employer: 7-Eleven Inc Expires: 11/13/2026 We Began As An Original. We Remain An Original At The Top Of The Convenience Industry. jobs.description: Employer: McKesson Expires: 11/13/2026 About the RoleThis summer, you'll join a B2B healthcare product marketing team and help accelerate its impact — using AI to move from one-off prompts to autonomous, workflow-level agents that change how the team operates. CoverMyMeds is seeking a curious, analytical intern interested in the craft of product marketing (positioning, messaging, buyer insight, enablement, go-to-market) and sees AI as a force multiplier for that craft, not a substitute for it. The ideal candidate is a marketer at heart: passionate about understanding buyers, shaping how products are positioned and brought to market, and telling stories that resonate — and excited to apply AI to do all of it faster, sharper, and at greater scale. What You'll DoDoing the PMM work, faster — you'll help drive smarter product marketing workstreams — product positioning and messaging, buyer and competitive insights, commercial enablement, go-to-market support — and use AI to move through them.Moving from assistants to agents — help us graduate from one-off AI prompts to repeatable, semi-autonomous workflows that run parts of our process.Driving participation — be a champion for AI adoption across the team: demo tools, run enablement sessions, lower the barrier to entry for teammates who are AI-curious but not yet AI-confident.Measuring success — help define what "AI-enabled product marketing impact" means, then build the tracking.Optimizing impact with AI — find the highest-leverage places where AI can speed up actionable market signals, sharpen messaging, or scale our output, and prove it with results.Where you might plug in (you won't do all of these — you'll go deep where the business needs you most):Positioning & messagingPersonas & segmentationSales enablementGo-to-market planning What You'll GainHands-on experience in B2B healthcare technology and product marketing, with a dedicated mentor.Exposure to how a Fortune-class healthcare business runs product marketing.Ownership of 1-2 projects, giving experience applying AI and automation to real business challenges.Opportunities to influence how a modern marketing organization evolves from traditional workflows to AI-powered ways of working. QualificationsA marketing student — pursuing Marketing, Business, Communications, or related degree— with a genuine interest in product marketing craft (positioning, messaging, buyer insight) and a curiosity for AI amplification.Strong interest in AI, marketing technology, and innovation.Excellent research, analytical, and communication skills.Experience with generative AI tools such as Copilot, Writer, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar.Comfort with ambiguity, a bias towards action and curiosity about healthcare Success in This RoleBy the end of the internship, you will have helped increase Product Marketing output, accelerated research and content development, improved AI adoption across key workflows, and contributed to measurable gains in team efficiency and strategic impact. Join us in helping redefine the future of Product Marketing through AI.

jobs.title: IT Field Manager Intern at 7-Eleven Inc
jobs.description: Employer: 7-Eleven Inc Expires: 11/13/2026 Job DescriptionWe Began As An Original. We Remain An Original At The Top Of The Convenience Industry. Our company invented the concept of convenience retailing. But we didn’t stop there. 7-Eleven® has captured the world with a proven willingness and ability to innovate. We were the first company in America to offer fresh-brewed to-go coffee. More than six million of our Slurpee® beverages have been sipped since 1966. And, to continuously stay ahead of the curve, we introduce more than 2,500+ new products each year. With over 86,000 global locations, 7-Eleven Inc. is the world’s largest operator, franchiser and licensor of convenience stores and is also one of the nation’s largest independent gasoline retailers. The company continues to achieve operational accolades, win awards in franchising and drive innovation in retail in the mission to make life a little easier for our guests by being where they need us, when they need us. About these Opportunities: 7-Eleven Inc. has several opportunities for Summer Internships. Each internship opportunity will occur during the summer months, (11 weeks), focused on a specific functional area, and will provide the candidate with a depth experience within the area, culminating in a project presentation to functional leaders. Each intern will work closely with a coach who will meet regularly to discuss project progress, provide direction and ongoing feedback. In addition, each intern will attend a lunch series which will provide a cross-functional view into the organization and give the interns exposure to senior leadership. The interns will also have the experience of touring a store and learning about our distribution systems. In this role, the individual will act as a vital link between IT, Store Operations and various Store Support Center departments to improve and simplify stores processes and systems. Serves as RIS expert and escalation point for Operations Management for resolution of store RIS issues, 7hub, Store IA and related tools used to support the operations team. Responsibilities:Obtain knowledge of Store RIS System & how different application work by spending time in 7-Eleven store & working with dedicated IT Field Manager.Analyze ServiceNow Case data to identify trends and opportunity stores in every regions for proactive monitoring & addressing root cause.Review daily open network cases to ensure proper resolution process being followed to get issues resolved within reasonable time frame,Work with assigned IT Field Manager to gain knowledge of cash report process from start to finish & get familiar with procedural cash report issues.Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) session for all new software/hardware in lab stores before production release.Participate extensively in pilot phase of new software and hardware releases and ensures that system issues are reported timely and effectively to the project and support teams during pilotProvide input into system development and procedures improvements through consultation with Operations and Store Support Center departments.Work with Operations to address area specific solutions/procedures for unusual/"One-off" sales situations.Maintain extensive understanding of how and why systems and applications work the way that they do in order to develop communications and address issues and issues within assigned regions/zones.Serve as the business liaison and primary contact for all RIS and 7hub communications to and from the field regarding system functionality, design, rollout, and ongoing upgrades and enhancements. Qualifications:Pursuing a degree (Bachelor’s or Master’s) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related technical field graduating December 2027 or May 2028.Exceptional attention to detail, time management and prioritization skillsAbility to independently lead projects and collaborate with cross-functional colleaguesUnderstand of the RIS (Retail Information System) including POS, ISP. GOT, and Scanner functionalityStrong verbal and written communication skills; ability to communicate effectively across multiple stakeholders, including senior managementStrong problem resolution skills; able to provide solutions and recommendations for resolutionExcellent verbal and written communication skills.Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel and other Microsoft Office applications
